_about: Character profiles reconstructed from mat quotes, flavor text and campaign cards. 'versions' are wiki pages for each printed version of the character. 'pronouns' only when the texts make them clear; otherwise omitted. 'hooks' are story seeds for expedition generation. relationship types: family, partner, mentor, student, friend, rival, enemy, companion, creator.

characters.name: Brama
characters.summary: The oldest living human, a young Sister Initiate during the Calamity who defied her elders to lead a pilgrimage to a defensible city and found Gravehold. She brought the sister-words down from The World That Was, counselled sealing the cave and became high elder. Her faith is Gravehold's best weapon — and with age it hardens into paranoia: she exiles Yan Magda, Garu, Arachnos and Xaxos' students, and in the civil war becomes a nemesis to Z'hana's side. Once the rebel against tradition, she becomes the institution.

relationships.note: stood by her when the conclaves split
Xaxos was her pupil; she raised him after Raven

hooks: Brama sends the team on a mission but withholds part of the truth
a younger Brama leads refugees across the wasteland
Brama's mind is taken by a Nameless and must be freed

characters.name: Xaxos
characters.summary: Born in Karek's archive as the First Tribe froze, raised by the archivist Raven (who called the child her 'little girl') and then by Brama. Unable to learn the sister-words like the other girls, Xaxos studied the tribe's books, runes and the Void. As a Gravehold adept he preached learning from the Nameless, led a masked blood-magic circle and, seeking power to protect the city, drew Maelstrom into Gravehold — causing The Fall and Dezmodia's death. He fled into the Void, returned 'Ascended' and was defeated; in exile he coined 'Void essence', rescued a girl from the Changeling Nest and raised her as his daughter Qu, fought the Reliquary and came back redeemed as the Outcast to face the Fountain of Souls. His descendants still carry claws and fangs.
hooks: Xaxos' old notes resurface
a breach opened by Xaxos' followers
Xaxos returns from the Void with a warning
a relic from the First Tribe's archive

characters.name: Mist
characters.summary: Dagger captain who rose through the guard 'as though born for the task' and walked into the breach three times; not brave, only desperate to live. On the fourth trip a crystalline sound entered and remade her: 'I am the vessel now.' She saves survivors at The Fall, discovers the living surface, teaches adult initiates like Soskel, and is forbidden to Voidwalk. In the end she becomes the final villain, Mist Revealed, unleashing a Second Fall to unite humanity against her.
traits: self-sacrificing to the point of monstrosity

relationships.note: his closest substitute; believes the Knight is him

hooks: Mist returns from a scouting trip with a strange gem
something came back with Mist from the breach

characters.name: Malastar
characters.summary: Trainer of younglings and designer of the Ordeal; later New Gravehold's forge-master who crafts equipment from Nameless remains and invents synthetic gems. Married to Kadir, father of Claudia; thinks of Z'hana as a sister but sides against her.

relationships.note: first to call her a prodigy

hooks: Malastar needs Nameless remains or rare ore for new equipment
harvest the pods

characters.name: Kadir
characters.summary: Delver of the deeps who seeks a sleeping god and a shadow city beneath Gravehold, and guides younglings on their Ordeal. Later a gem scientist on the surface, married to Malastar, mother of Claudia; a staunch traditionalist against Z'hana.
hooks: a delve into the deepest caves
the sleeping god of the troggs

characters.name: Adelheim
characters.summary: Gruff, loyal smith who mends looted, blood-rusted weapons on the pilgrimage and later forges breach-ore blades and odd contraptions in Gravehold; admires the craftsmanship of monsters.
hooks: a forge that needs breach-touched ore
weapons still clutched by skeletons of an abandoned village

characters.name: Jian
characters.summary: Orphan whose father Yohn Thrant died touching the Focusing Orb; she picked it up and never spoke again. Sees time as a web; expects to save worlds and become nothing.
hooks: a silent child who knows where the breach will open

characters.name: Lash
characters.summary: Scout who laughs anyway; loves the dirt market and the people who keep living. Looks after the young Dezmodia.
hooks: a scout's report from the cave walls

characters.name: Phaedraxa
characters.summary: Seer who spoke the sister-words before she could walk; the only one who remembers The World That Was and sees Gravehold's fate in the web of time.
hooks: a prophecy about the coming battle

characters.name: Z'hana
characters.summary: One of three survivors of the Far Hollow fire, where she lost her parents and found her magic. Slept in the crypts for her ideas and secretly removed one stone from the sealed cave mouth on every visit. Lost her husband Soren in The Fall, raised Taqren alone. Opposed exiling Xaxos' students, then became the traitor mage — using glyphs and human aether to drive Necroswarm — and led the Void-mages and Azer against Brama. Most prolific author of new spells in the Grimoire.
hooks: cloaked figures maintaining glyphs at the edge of the battle
a veteran's tattoo on a fleeing mage's ankle

characters.name: Nym
characters.summary: Malastar's most gifted and reckless apprentice; refuses to fear or respect monsters; had never seen stars.
hooks: an apprentice who runs ahead

characters.name: Reeve
characters.summary: One-armed warrior who cut off her own arm to stop tainted jade; never sleeps, sharpens her chopper and runs toward the bells.
hooks: tainted jade creeping through a wound

characters.name: Garu
characters.summary: Horned giant who wandered the Void and pulled Yan Magda from her sarcophagus; haunted by a child's voice he cannot name. Gentle with children who fear him. Later exiled by Brama for trying to open a Void portal.
hooks: a child's voice from the breach

characters.name: Yan Magda
characters.summary: Sentenced by The Conclave to eternal sleep for questioning them; freed in the Void, she gathered orphans as a would-be army of vengeance — until she met the lost child Indira and chose to belong. Branded a heretic, teacher of Indira and Dezmodia, she spoke the true name of the world, Khasad Vol. Eventually exiled to a cottage in the wilds, she calls Brama a coward who made a good leader.
hooks: Yan Magda's knowledge of the Void is the only way through
a visit to an exile's cottage

characters.name: Dezmodia
characters.summary: Born in the Void as her mother died, delivered by Yan Magda; her years are 'not what they seem'. A child who fears no death, then a prodigy who scorns Brama. At The Fall she erupted and buried Maelstrom. Reborn part-Nameless in the Void with Xaxos, she returns cold, sensing a great storm gathering beyond.
hooks: a Void-born sense of the coming storm

characters.name: Indira
characters.summary: A one-breach youngling lost in her Ordeal, found by Yan Magda — and denied mage rank by Brama for it. Gravehold's chronicler of the War Eternal sieges. She pulled the child Nook from the ruins and became his anchor; later she time-travels as the Light Caller. Calls herself a coward for watching her friends' exile.
hooks: Indira's chronicle of a past siege
someone stuck between timelines

characters.name: Quilius
characters.summary: Raised by cavern monks after killing a monster with her father's dagger as a child; follows a path of five kills toward 'the mind of the gods'. 'I am the monster. Give me a hunt.'
hooks: a hunt for a specific beast that must be the one

characters.name: Mazahaedron
characters.summary: Mystic who hears the world as a living mother and never lets his feet touch the hallowed earth below Gravehold; his brothers fade above. Remembers the forgotten gods.
hooks: the cave speaks — a mystic interprets it

characters.name: Gex
characters.summary: Hammer-wielding advisor who chose a plain grey rock as a gem to hide the geode inside; keeps powers in reserve against the exiles.
hooks: hidden reasons, hidden powers

characters.name: Sparrow
characters.summary: Once frail and timid — hence the nickname — now a blunt soldier who beheaded the Prophet and wants the exiles kept on the front line.
hooks: a soldier who distrusts an ally

characters.name: Ohat and Ulgimor
characters.summary: A self-confessed coward of the dirt market whose shadow was claimed by a fragment of the Umbra Titan, Ulgimor. Ulgimor drove the Titan into The Depths and later sheltered Ohat through The Fall; they lived alone in the ruins for decades and learned to cooperate. Employs Gadymir.
hooks: a survivor living in the ruins

characters.name: Remnant
characters.summary: A fragment of someone lost, 'an intention given form', who remembers only pain and must persist until its task is fulfilled; guardian of Gravehold's children.
hooks: a ghostly figure that guides the lost

characters.name: Kain
characters.summary: One of Yan Magda's Void orphans who sees the Void as beautiful and dances for life and change.
hooks: a guide who loves the Void

characters.name: Tressa
characters.summary: Treasure-hunting mage who found a reason to care for the city when her son Nook was born; Yan Magda talked her into fighting with her stash.
hooks: a treasure that glitters too much

characters.name: Thraxir
characters.summary: A Follower who opened a breach with his sword, against all doctrine, and stood with Brama when the conclaves split. Gravehold's breach commander, killed by Rageborne; returned from The Depths as the Knight of Shackles commanding the dead; restored at the Fountain of Souls, his armour now an eternal shackle.
hooks: the dead rise from The Depths
can a corrupted hero be saved?

characters.name: Inco
characters.summary: Raised in the wilds by Necroswarm and its plant creatures; found by Talix in ruins and adopted. Speaks to plants, loves Razra. Watched Z'hana drive his caretaker to raze Southpost; later carried its sapling to a grove in the Void. 'It is not magic that corrupts.'

relationships.note: implied former Tether (green hair, wandered into the woods)

hooks: the plants are dying
plants guide the way

characters.name: Razra
characters.summary: Reckless twin of Mazra who struggled with lessons until she befriended Rip, a large sleek metallic creature, and raced through training. Kidnapped by Z'hana's glyph-trap; later finds Azer and wants to punch Z'hana in the nose once.
hooks: a mage who went ahead alone
Rip finds something

characters.name: Rip
characters.summary: Razra's metallic beast companion; turns matter or thoughts into energy, chomps through walls of fire.
hooks: Rip stumbles in wounded, leading the way

characters.name: Mazra
characters.summary: Youngest breach mage ever (ten), archive-obsessed, aspiring head of the council; finds the Grimoire; shaken by the traitor, she takes a sabbatical at the Northern Outpost.
hooks: the archives hold a record of this Nameless

characters.name: Talix
characters.summary: Exuberant explorer from Southpost who found and adopted Inco; partner of Soskel. Was aged to an old man by the Ageless Walker and restored.
hooks: a missing teammate who buried the treasures

characters.name: Soskel
characters.summary: Wealthy-born nobody who carried children through The Fall, became an adult initiate under Mist, and was made expedition commander by Brama for understanding those he leads. Captured by Arachnos and infused with Void essence; runs the Northern Outpost; Talix's partner.
hooks: a commander's missing expedition

characters.name: Rhia
characters.summary: Blunt relic expert with crystalline hair grown when she poured her magic into one of her father's artifacts as a dying child; burns Nameless corpses so they don't poison the soil.
hooks: a survivor guarding the party's artifacts

characters.name: Lost
characters.summary: A mage of Old Gravehold bound to a suit of armour with a heart of fire, memory shattered, forging weapons in a bunker with his squirrel Meek. In sunken Gravehold he broke into a sealed forge holding journals and an old corpse.
hooks: a hidden bunker full of weapons
a ghost of the past

characters.name: Claudia
characters.summary: Hyperactive genius daughter of Kadir and Malastar who feels everyone's aether; could not have an Ordeal because Gravehold was gone.
hooks: a gadget that might work

characters.name: Gygar
characters.summary: Treasure hunter who dives the sunken ruins of Old Gravehold with Kadir's air-holding spell; impatient with the council's debates.
hooks: an underwater expedition
a sunken treasure

characters.name: Sahala
characters.summary: Child of a mage whom Xaxos saved; uses the fallen-star meteorite they recovered. Believes Xaxos can be saved and later becomes a sister to Qu.
hooks: a meteorite in a cellar

characters.name: Qu
characters.summary: Taken by goblins to the Changeling Nest as a child, cut from a cocoon by Xaxos and raised in the Void, aging strangely (white hair while young). Escapes to New Gravehold through a breach, half monstrous; loves Taqren and returns to the Void at her father's call.
hooks: a girl who walks out of a breach

characters.name: Taqren
characters.summary: Son of Z'hana and Soren, pulled from the collapsing tunnels; told to 'become their shield, not a weapon'. Defends his mother as misguided, not a traitor; loves Qu.
hooks: a son who must choose between his mother and his city

characters.name: Nook
characters.summary: Tressa's son, pulled as a grimy child from the ruins by Indira. Became New Gravehold's finest scientist and built a miniature Void portal that devoured his breaches and mind; time now scatters around him. His time experiments (The Anomaly) may snap time itself.
hooks: an experiment that went wrong
the same battle happening twice

characters.name: Cairna
characters.summary: Crushed by rubble in The Fall and assumed dead, she woke buried alive, made the rocks answer her without training and built herself legs of stone; survived alone in the ruins for years.
hooks: a survivor who knows the tunnels

characters.name: Kel
characters.summary: Sour-faced, fiercely caring Azerian Tether of Ilya; fights only for her village and her beloved.
hooks: Azer asks for help — reluctantly

characters.name: Ilya
characters.summary: Hopeful Azerian Tether of Kel who sees aether connecting all things; wants Brama and Z'hana to stop fighting for the people's sake.
hooks: two Tethers must hold hands to survive

characters.name: Lucien
characters.summary: Azerian mage who lost his Tether Phy to a Portalborn and goes on, inevitable as the tide.
hooks: a mage avenging a lost partner

characters.name: Reth
characters.summary: Tether-less Azerian who tears open conduits and lets power overwhelm her; her childhood Tether, a green-haired boy who loved plants, wandered into the woods and never came back.
hooks: a rose kept from someone she'd rather forget

characters.name: Arachnos
characters.summary: Xaxos' devoted student who rebelled against New Gravehold and was banished; sacrificed his friend Karak to a ritual, created Maggoth, Fenrix and Experiment 153 and fused with a Void spider — 'the only human to create a Nameless'. He became the World Devourer, then was reborn clear-minded thanks to Z'hana's Void journey.
hooks: a ritual site in the woods
an exile's journal

characters.name: Karak
characters.summary: Arachnos' friend who volunteered for the ritual and aged into bones, then into a Nameless with no memory of being human.
hooks: a follower transformed

characters.name: Raven
characters.summary: Archivist of Karek, last of the First Tribe, who survived the night of emeralds while giving birth to Xaxos and carried what books she could; not a fighter, not a storyteller, but she learned for her child.
hooks: a fragment of the Karek archive
the crystal statues of the First Tribe

characters.name: Janti
characters.summary: A woman the elders said could not learn the sister-words, who earned her place in the Sisterhood anyway; Brama's proof that hope exists.
hooks: proving the elders wrong

characters.name: Leisan
characters.summary: Hunter who treats Nameless as animals, takes trophies — antlers, claws, marrow — and eats their power.
hooks: a trophy from a past kill

characters.name: Alcheia
characters.summary: Gem-loving rebel of the monks' caverns who volunteered to accompany Quilius on her hunt just to get out.
hooks: a volunteer with ulterior motives

characters.name: Kiri Maesan
characters.summary: Young Erythizan scientist who lived among phoenixes and learned breach magic from them; adores her phoenix.
hooks: a field journal from the jungle

characters.name: Kavoc
characters.summary: Sleep-deprived university researcher of the white space beyond breaches who left a compendium of thousands of spells in Karek's archive.
hooks: a restricted book

characters.name: Auren
characters.summary: Inventor with a face more scale than skin who builds automatons and dreams of flying craft; the blueprints outlive their maker.
hooks: ancient blueprints

characters.name: Ona
characters.summary: A mother whose tendrils grow daily; preparing to give up her name while her son Solein studies in Erythiza to cure her.
hooks: a memory box for a child

characters.name: Nadea
characters.summary: Port Hanon guard who subdues the feral corrupted and intends to descend to Gravehold with dignity when the time comes.
hooks: a guard escorting the corrupted

characters.name: Willow
characters.summary: A runaway heir who fled the crown, stowed away to Port Hanon and invents magic despite warnings it hastens corruption.
hooks: a runaway with a stolen inheritance

characters.name: Bayli
characters.summary: Self-proclaimed greatest mage ever to toss a spark, stuck in peaceful Souston and dreaming of Old Gravehold's legends.
hooks: a young hero who finally gets a quest

characters.name: Shoshana
characters.summary: Descendant of Faen Tethers forbidden to become Tethered, who takes the tattoos anyway out of love for village and friends.
hooks: a family heirloom from before the civil war

characters.name: Naftir
characters.summary: Great-great-grandchild of Xaxos, born without visible corruption but feeling the Void's teeth inside; sees the outline of a wolf.
hooks: an inheritance of the Void

characters.name: Lilly
characters.summary: A child who followed a furry Void creature through its portal and plays there still, waiting for a sundown that never comes. Her mother's pet was silver with big teeth and her father was raised by a Nameless near Southpost — by every clue, Razra and Inco's daughter.
hooks: a lost child in the Void

characters.name: Rhys
characters.summary: Never the girl a mother wanted, Rhys lost the sister-words and rebuilt magic with artificial breaches from Auren's ancient blueprints, then rebuilt Rhys' own body as part machine.
hooks: a machine that opens breaches

characters.name: Dorian
characters.summary: Young visionary decades in the future who uses the aether of past and future, breaking causality for a chunk of jade.
hooks: aether borrowed from tomorrow

characters.name: Stake
characters.summary: Cindercrown professor of Breach Theory who takes a sabbatical into the System to find relics, preaching curiosity.
hooks: an academic expedition into dangerous tunnels

characters.name: Wolf
characters.summary: Hard-bitten Strike leader who patrols the System so Upper Crowners can forget the Nameless exist.
hooks: a patrol in the System

characters.name: Dai
characters.summary: Young, agile Strike scout who thinks on their feet.
hooks: a scout's warning

characters.name: Dalana
characters.summary: Brama's childhood friend who could not speak the sister-words; healer and poet of 'Journey's End'.
hooks: a healer joins the party

characters.name: Fawn
characters.summary: Old would-be witch whose lifetime of failed words made the new alchemy easy.
hooks: a potion for the storm

characters.name: Myrna
characters.summary: Keeper of her grandmother's journal and her ancestors' stories.
hooks: a grandmother's journal

characters.name: Joanna
characters.summary: Merchant who keeps craftspeople and miners paid; 'anything you need, my dirt market provides'.
hooks: a deal at the dirt market

characters.name: Grimoire
characters.summary: Book rescued from The Fall recording every spell known, with entries by Brama, Lash and Z'hana.
hooks: a spell written by a mage long gone

characters.name: Lexive
characters.summary: Theorist of magic quoted throughout New Gravehold's era (namesake of the ancient scholar Antoni Lexive).
hooks: a theory to test in battle

characters.name: Nerva
characters.summary: Ordinary survivor of Gravehold whose testimonies record the sieges.
hooks: an eyewitness account

characters.name: Ghan
characters.summary: Gem scavenger of the caves.
hooks: a scavenger finds tainted gems

characters.name: Ruya
characters.summary: Surface scout who reports on poisoned winds and conjured grapples.
hooks: a scout's warning about the winds

characters.name: Gadymir
characters.summary: New mage whose memory was eaten by the Maiden of Thorns; now pulls Ohat's cart.
hooks: a victim who forgot his name

characters.name: Frayla
characters.summary: Inexperienced mage crushed by the falling Prophet.
hooks: a memorial for the fallen

characters.name: Camellia
characters.summary: Head woman of Souston who taught glyph carving.
hooks: the glyphs around Souston are failing

characters.name: Perth
characters.summary: Azerian mage fighting without Tether Xander.
hooks: a Tether alone

characters.name: Yohn Thrant
characters.summary: Jian's father, killed by the Focusing Orb.

characters.name: Soleil D'Arca
epithets: Head Scientist of the Royal Erythiza Academy
characters.summary: Scientist whose study of The Hunger unleashed the Oracle of Filth; 'a tragedy, of course'.
hooks: a scientist who refuses to destroy her specimen

characters.name: Xae
characters.summary: Captain of the Mage's Faction of Mynerva's Guild, sent through a portal to Gravehold. Digital crossover promo, not main canon.
hooks: a visitor from another world

characters.name: Soren
characters.summary: Z'hana's husband and Taqren's father; died fighting Maelstrom in the collapsing tunnels during The Fall.
hooks: a memorial to those lost in The Fall

characters.name: Necroswarm
characters.summary: Plant Nameless that lived peacefully far to the south and raised Inco, until the traitor mage's glyphs drove it north to raze Southpost.
hooks: a once-kind Nameless driven mad

characters.name: Phy
characters.summary: Lucien's Tether, who called him 'my tide'; killed by a Portalborn.

characters.name: Solein
characters.summary: Ona's son, studying at the university of Erythiza to cure the corruption before his mother gives up her name.
hooks: a student searching for a cure in Erythiza

characters.name: Xander
characters.summary: Perth's absent Tether, who used to help tame Perth's spells.

characters.name: Kiri's Phoenix
characters.summary: A juvenile phoenix who befriended Kiri Maesan and opened breaches before her eyes; learns to fight at her side.
hooks: a phoenix who leads the way
